channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US moves aircraft from second UK base over ‘threat from Iran’
item.description: Two refuelling tankers and several other aircraft diverted from RAF Mildenhall airbase ​to other locations, WSJ reports.

item.title: Khor Mor drone attack raises fears over Iraq’s energy security
item.description: Drone strike disrupts electricity supply in Iraq's semi-autonomous Kurdish region, renewing concerns about armed groups.

item.title: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh after Houthi attack on pipeline
item.description: Saudi forces intercept two missiles fired towards Riyadh, hours after reporting damage to key East-West pipeline.

item.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
item.description: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.

item.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
item.description: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

item.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
item.description: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.
